prompts.front: Use case: product-mockup / precise-object-edit. Create ONE standalone portrait 1024x1536 studio ecommerce photograph of an ACID-WASH BLACK pullover hoodie. Image 1 provides the hoodie cut, washed fabric construction and reference design. Image 2 provides the authoritative COMPLETE IIT Mandi chest logo and approved Cream Mountain back artwork. Make the garment genuinely BLACK with cool charcoal-grey faded acid-wash mottling, not brown, not bronze, not a crackle/leopard pattern. Preserve a kangaroo pocket, black drawstrings, hood, ribbed cuffs and hem, relaxed fit. Use neutral off-white seamless studio backdrop and soft even lighting consistent with our campus product photographs. Front left chest carries the COMPLETE original IIT Mandi institute emblem, including bridge, coloured mountain/sun accents and full white institution wording "Indian Institute of Technology Mandi". Back carries cream arched uppercase collegiate "IIT MANDI", the detailed alpine mountain illustration, and exact cream tagline "IITians in Himalayas". No CAPRA logo, no extra graphics, no captions, no watermark. Ghost mannequin styling, no person, no visible mannequin or hanger. This is one single photograph, never a collage or split-screen. FRONT VIEW ONLY: show the entire one hoodie centred from hood to hem, small complete institute emblem on the wearer's left chest. Back print is not visible. No rear view or second garment.
